comment: Data and workflow baseline — A modern ICD-11 decision should be tested against the information chain and the intended uses. This adapts the useful evaluation method in the supplied bit4health standards survey, especially §§1.2–1.3 and 5.1–5.2; it does not import its 2004 product assessments.

public.text: Data and workflow baseline — A modern ICD-11 decision should be tested against the information chain and the intended uses. This adapts the useful evaluation method in the supplied bit4health standards survey, especially §§1.2–1.3 and 5.1–5.2; it does not import its 2004 product assessments.
public.suggestedRevision: Insert paragraph: Alongside the system inventory, inventory the clinical statements, forms, datasets, classifications, terminology releases, reporting obligations, and exchanges already in use. Trace the priority data flows from capture through clinical use to reporting, identifying who records or transforms the information, which rules apply, and where detail is lost or collected again. Evaluate candidate standards against the actual use cases, coverage, implementation maturity, maintained tooling, governance, conformance evidence, and total lifecycle cost. Record the reasons for each selection and any identified gaps.
